Reference1 and reference2 are FULL character sheets for game-style/edge-quality guidance only; preserve their images unchanged and DO NOT draw any characters from them. Match their clear graphic readability while using deliberately chunkier, simpler SQUARE PIXEL CLUSTERS for these small VFX.
